video_title: Why One of the World’s Biggest Investors Is ALL-IN in European Basketball ? | Gili Raanan

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on the uncapped potential of European basketball
quotes.excerpt: The starting point is so low that the potential I believe is uncapped!
quotes.quote: European basketball has a tremendous future. The starting point is so low that the potential I believe is uncapped! The shift in European basketball is happening right now.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on co-investing with Steph Curry in tech companies
quotes.excerpt: Three years ago, I made contact with a very famous athlete named Steph Curry.
quotes.quote: Three years ago, I made contact with a very famous athlete named Steph Curry. Following that, we started to co-invest in some tech companies.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on the similarities between professional sports and business
quotes.excerpt: Sport and competitive sport is very, very similar to business.
quotes.quote: For me, sport and competitive sport is very, very similar to business. I started to get really interested in athletes and what is going through their life as I went deeper in understanding what is going through the life of entrepreneurs, of tech entrepreneurs. I spotted a lot of commonalities. Athletes have to perform every day. It doesn't matter what happened last night, what happened with their partner, what happened with their parents, what happened with their life. They get a lot of coverage in the press, mostly when they fail, if they had a miserable game, and what do you do then?

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on his decision to become an owner of Hapoel
quotes.excerpt: I didn't really have a plan to get into Hapoel as an owner.
quotes.quote: I didn't really have a plan to get into Hapoel as an owner. I thought to support the team. My son is a big fan of the club. I made a mistake and took him to some games when he was 11 or 12, and those are the formation ages for boys, and it became a disease. I met with Ofer Yanai, my partner today at Hapoel, and I literally fell in love. I thought, okay, that's an amazing project to run.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on the importance of curiosity for investors
quotes.excerpt: Being a very curious person is the foundation of being an okay investor.
quotes.quote: I am in an ongoing process of educating myself. I am not fooling myself. I know it all, and that's, you know, being a very curious person is the foundation of being an okay investor. You have to stay curious about, first of all, about people and about new fields and new technologies. And for me, you know, I approach basketball in the same way. I am curious about people. I love to understand what drives them, what motivates them.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on his investment philosophy of focusing on people
quotes.excerpt: I don't ask them about technology or their product idea. I ask them about their childhood.
quotes.quote: When I interview entrepreneurs before the investment, I don't ask them about technology or their product idea. Initially, I don't care about those. I ask them about their childhood and about their mama, and I try to understand what makes them tick, what made them the individuals they are today. I am not looking for the smartest kid in the room. Being smart doesn't hurt, of course, it's a good thing, but it's not the most important thing. I try to understand what's their experience going through pain in life, real pain, going through real difficulties.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on the value of building imperfect teams
quotes.excerpt: It's about creating teams and making imperfect teams deliver.
quotes.quote: It's about creating teams and making imperfect teams deliver, because if you have a perfect team, you don't need any talent. It's a perfect team. What can you say? It would be boring almost.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on why everything in business is personal
quotes.excerpt: In my business, everything is personal. There's nothing that just business.
quotes.quote: I am saying to everyone, in my business, everything is personal. There's nothing that just business. If it's just business, it means you don't care, and I care. I care about my companies. I care about my basketball team. It's personal. It's not just business.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on why he invested in Hapoel
quotes.excerpt: It was Ofer, the individual, his story, the way he grew up, what he achieved.
quotes.quote: It was Ofer, the individual, his story, the way he grew up, what he achieved, the real-life difficulties he went through, and I looked at Ofer and I felt immediate connection and empathy, the very same way I felt with entrepreneurs I invested in. Many times, I am starting a conversation with an entrepreneur and within 10 minutes I know I am an investor, and then it takes me three or four years to figure out why, because it's an instinct.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on his role as a mentor to entrepreneurs
quotes.excerpt: You cannot develop the inner voice in a person, but you can teach a younger person.
quotes.quote: You cannot develop the inner voice in a person, but you can teach a younger person to listen and connect to their inner voice and trust the inner voice. In many ways, education system, society tell us to not to trust our inner voice. They are giving us all kind of analytic tools and be rational, and they give us this structure, and that's the right way to do things, where there isn't right way to do things. Who knows what's the right way? And who am I to tell you what's the right way? So what I can teach you and what I can help you with, and that's what I try to do with entrepreneurs, is not to teach them how to do things, to teach them how to be the best versions of themselves.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on the ownership structure of Hapoel
quotes.excerpt: It's not just Ofer and I, you know, we are three owners in Hapoel.
quotes.quote: It's not just Ofer and I, you know, we are three owners in Hapoel. Recently, my friend Mickey Malca joined us, and Mickey, you should interview Mickey. Mickey is a terrific, terrific individual and a very successful tech entrepreneur and investor by his own, being the first investor in companies like Coinbase and Robinhood.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on his long-term vision for European basketball
quotes.excerpt: European basketball, not just Hapoel, has a tremendous future.
quotes.quote: I believe that European basketball, not just Hapoel, has a tremendous future. The starting point is so low that the potential I believe is uncapped, and we are watching some tectonic shifts in European basketball. When you compare where we are here in Europe in terms of basketball and the quality of the game, but also the business, relative to our brothers and sisters in North America, you see that there is so much room we can go through.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on the possibility of an NBA team in Europe
quotes.excerpt: I don't have my crystal ball with me here, so it's hard to tell the future.
quotes.quote: I don't have my crystal ball with me here, so it's hard to tell the future, but I believe that that's their intention 100%. Whether they do that and how well they do that and what's the exact formation it would take, there are more than one options, but one thing is certain in my mind that, you know, we would meet here, and if you'll be kind enough to interview me three years from now, we would look at completely different scene of European basketball.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.excerpt: I think I I grew up in the 80s in a small town, 20 kilometers away from Tel Aviv.
quotes.quote: I think I grew up in the 80s in a small town, 20 kilometers away from Tel Aviv. And for people who were not born and lived in the 80s, it was pre-smartphone, pre-internet, pre-computers. So if you grew up in a small town, you are completely isolated from the world. So, Tel Aviv was only 20 kilometers away and probably one bus ride away and still it looks to me, you know, traveling to Tel Aviv was like traveling to the moon. It's something that doesn't happen very often, and I had this passion to really get to know the world and explore, and I was waiting to meet you and get to know you, based on the same unsatisfied hunger for information that was instilled in me when I was a 10-year-old boy, hungry to get to know the world and there's no way it was very frustrating.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on his operating system for success
quotes.excerpt: I think it's the type of, using the tech analogy, it's an operating system.
quotes.quote: I think it's the type of, using the tech analogy, it's an operating system that was set in the early 80s and it's still, you know, with some bugs, continues to operate. It's a product of the 80s, that's what that's the product.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on the common traits of successful people
quotes.excerpt: I think that they don't have in common one thing.
quotes.quote: I think that they don't have in common one thing. I think that you you look at very successful super achievers and they they come in many different forms and shapes. I don't think there is one formula to to become super successful, and that's the beauty of the game, that, you know, you were given in the game certain cards and you were not given some other cards that other people have, and you have to look at your cards and play them right.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on the value of associating with great athletes
quotes.excerpt: I believe that, personally, the journey of building lasting businesses, tremendous companies is a very hard journey.
quotes.quote: I believe that, personally, the journey of building lasting businesses, tremendous companies is a very hard journey. It's emotionally, psychologically, it's super hard. So looking at others and the way they deal with pressure, with downtimes, with failures, with picking the wrong team members, you know, that gives you comfort, because it's a very lonely journey and many entrepreneurs, you know, tend to think that they are alone. They are the first person that really tackle that type of challenge. Just and very often just the feedback that says, you're not alone, and you're not the first person that, you know, faced that challenge, and you know what? Some people managed to overcome that challenge. It doesn't mean that the challenge is not difficult. It is difficult, but some other people faced it and they managed to overcome it. That understanding alone many times is enough for the athlete or for the entrepreneur to really recharge and move forward, because they say, okay, if some other, you know, some other people managed to overcome that challenge, why wouldn't I be able to to do that? And that's enough.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on the Tel Aviv basketball derby
quotes.excerpt: The Tel Aviv derby, in my view, is the biggest sport event in basketball.
quotes.quote: The Tel Aviv derby, in my view, is the biggest sport event in basketball, definitely for any any Israeli. And on the other hand, I have tons of respect to what Maccabi has built as organization, you know, they playing in in Europe for many decades, they've been very successful. So from my perspective, it's the same respect a young tech entrepreneur should give IBM. They have paved the way, but now it's our time.

quotes.speaker: Gili Raanan
quotes.summary_phrase: Gili Raanan on his biggest win as an investor
quotes.excerpt: Maybe winning the NBA with Hapoel would be the biggest win ever.
quotes.quote: Probably not. Maybe winning the NBA with Hapoel would be the biggest win ever. But as I said, I'm not installing glass ceiling, so we shall see. But again, it's a recommendation for entrepreneurs I'm giving myself, regardless where the journey would take you, make sure you enjoy it. So I'm I'm working hard to to make sure I enjoy the journey.
